_about: Domain-free operation tags for the concept reading (v10, 2026-10-19). A skill gets 1-4; a task's concepts use the same tags, so matching is by operation, not by shared words. Add a tag only when a real skill or task needs it.

tags.partition: split a whole into non-overlapping parts or kinds
tags.classify: assign each item to a known kind
tags.select-best: choose among options under a rule
tags.generate-variants: produce many candidates from one source: brainstorm, mutate, paraphrase, permute
tags.combine-parents: breed or fuse two or more things into a new one
tags.analogize: map an idea from one domain onto another
tags.overlay-config: one frozen base plus switchable overrides on top
tags.switch-mode: change behaviour by selecting a mode or stance
tags.route-dispatch: send a request to the right handler
tags.decompose: break a task or thing into sub-parts
tags.order-dependencies: sequence steps by what each needs first
tags.conflict-detect: find where parts contradict or clash
tags.consistency-check: verify parts agree with each other or a rule
tags.gap-find: find what is missing or uncovered
tags.compare-versions: contrast two versions, branches or runs
tags.merge-land: join work together and land it
tags.summarize: compress many things into a short account
tags.uncertainty: put error bars or confidence on a number: confidence interval, standard error, bootstrap, credible interval, calibration, how sure
tags.significance: test whether an effect is real versus chance: p-value, hypothesis test, permutation test, multiple-testing correction, deflated Sharpe, false discovery
tags.null-baseline: compare against a do-nothing or random baseline
tags.plant-falsify: plant a known fault to prove a check can fail
tags.anomaly: spot what does not fit the pattern
tags.threshold-latch: trigger or hold state at a level
tags.retry-recover: retry, back off or recover from failure
tags.append-log: record events in an append-only log
tags.schedule-time: run things at times or reason about time
tags.monitor-watch: watch a running thing and alert
tags.guard-block: block a bad action before it happens
tags.sandbox-isolate: run in isolation so nothing leaks
tags.sample-random: draw a sample or test randomness: subsample, stratified or reservoir sample, shuffle, seeded random draw, Monte Carlo
tags.simulate: run a model forward to see outcomes
tags.optimize-search: search a space for a best setting
tags.graph-walk: reason over a network of links
tags.translate-convert: convert between formats, languages or platforms
tags.reframe-viewpoint: look from another point of view
tags.plain-language: rewrite for a reader in plain words
tags.plan-sequence: lay out a plan of steps
tags.enforce-checklist: check a document or report against required items
tags.handoff: pass work or context to another worker
tags.forget-expire: decide what to drop or let expire
tags.evolve-iterate: improve through repeated variation and selection
tags.red-team: attack a claim, rule or system to break it: critique, grill, counter-argue, find the weak spot or the hostile reading, refute, stress-test, poke holes
tags.steelman: build the strongest case for a view: the best version of an opposing argument before rebutting it
tags.elicit-ask: ask a person the questions that decide the work: interview, interrogate, grill the owner, clarify what they meant, a menu of their open decisions, hard questions aimed at the weak spot
tags.ingest-validate: take in outside data and validate it
tags.visualize: draw or render for the eye
tags.speed-up: make something faster with the same answers
tags.test-code: write or judge tests of code
